{{Top|leg}}
The '''Conjo fighter''' was a type of atmospheric fighter produced by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] and used by planetary defense forces which either couldn't afford or saw no need for true [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. These small wedge-shaped craft used combination [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]/[[ion afterburner]]s to achieve supersonic speeds, while sophisticated vector controls and atmospheric streamlining gave them incredible maneuverability. Many variants of Conjo fighters existed, including [[Conjo Y41-C2LC fighter|ground attack]], [[Conjo Y41-4LC fighter|air superiority]] and [[Conjo Y41-T fighter|trainer]] models.

There were three squadrons of Conjo fighters in the [[G'rho Defense Force]]. When the [[Ssi-ruu]] attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Brco]] ordered his Conjo fighters to attack. Two Conjo pilots were [[Trig Kilwallen|Trig]] and [[Seni Kilwallen]].
